physical_scope: Whole powered development board during frozen-feature head inference, including loop and scheduler; no camera, CNN feature extraction, training or update energy
limitations: One physical development board per platform. Board-level consumption is not isolated MCU/core energy.
Energy: three temporal windows in one recording/boot per configuration. Latency: three earlier reset/reflash sessions. They are distinct experiments.
S3/C3 share firmware recordings across variants; Mega uses one firmware/recording per variant. Mega variant comparisons are not paired session replicates.
No independent meter gain, time-base or response calibration and no hardware synchronization trigger. Numerical boundary sensitivity is not calibrated uncertainty.
Accumulated Wh differs from integrated VBUS*IBUS by approximately four throughout the series; Wh is excluded, and its discrepancy remains unexplained.
Mega polling baseline consumes more power than inference. All 42 active-minus-polling contrasts are negative and retained as signed diagnostics, not isolated inference energy.
Mega mlp_C1_v1 and kan_C2_v4 have about 3.9 s final padding instead of requested 5 s; all windows and +/-1 s sensitivity integrations are covered.
Mega alignment uses a common relative threshold rule chosen after waveform inspection, with all tested thresholds retained. No amplitude floor or sample clipping is applied.
KAN INT8 LUT interpolation remains floating point; MLP INT8 uses integer internal layers. Historical training budgets were not established equal.

C2 KAN INT8 changes 11 decisions versus original FP32 and loses five correct predictions (851 vs 856). FP32 LUT keeps 856 correct but changes two decisions; equal accuracy does not imply identical outputs.
